items: PGP in Management & Tech (end card wording)
PG Program in Management & Technology (end card wording)
product_mix.note: All 30 ads sell one full-time 18-month postgraduate programme in Bangalore, worded as 'MBA-equivalent PGP' in 29 ads' text (the 30th says 'immersive PGP'), 'PGP in Management & Tech' on 22 end cards, 'PG Program in Management & Technology' on 2 and no programme name on 6; 'MBA' is spoken in 22 ads and 'PGP' in none.

series.name: One interview closing line, three scripts
series.note: 'If I was a student ... like an SSB today, I do think that exposure would have helped' is spoken in five videos and six ads (c03, c05, c08), none of which labels who speaks.

series.name: Same footage in several shapes
series.note: Four ideas (c02, c03, c05, c10) run in two shapes each, 16:9 with 9:16, 4:5 or square; the first sentence is dropped or swapped in some cuts.

series.name: Early bird end card and headline
series.note: Four ads started on 17 and 19 Nov still carry 'Early Bird Deadline 1st November 2026', two in the headline and two on the end card.

series.name: Openings that run down the MBA
series.note: 11 of 30 ads open by calling the MBA or college outdated, dead, not enough or its graduates underused; 3 of them say 'outdated' and 'unemployable'.

series.name: Shared ad text and headline
series.note: 27 ads share one main text and one link description, 18 share the headline 'India's Only B-School Designed by Industry Leaders', and all 30 press 'Apply now' to one landing page.

series.name: 50 lakh in three meanings
series.note: The figure sits in 12 ads as a brand's scale, a target for D2C businesses and an offer of funding.

contradictions.text: The early bird deadline of 1 November 2026 is still in the headline of two ads started on 19 Nov and on the end card of two ads started on 17 Nov; the 4:5 cut of the same film has no date.
50 lakh is a brand scaled to 50 lakh rupees (caption), heard as 50 lakh copies in one cut, a D2C aim of 50 lakhs in just 12 [?] and a funding offer to a student, with no source for any.
The end card says 18-Month, the timeline cut promises results by month 3 and in less than a year, and a voiceover says 'the last two years'.

The programme is 'MBA student' and 'MBA graduates' in speech, 'MBA-equivalent PGP' in ad text, 'PGP in Management & Tech' on 22 end cards and 'PG Program in Management & Technology' on 2; PGP is never spoken.
The headline says 'India's Only B-School Designed by Industry Leaders' over videos that never say it, while one end card says 'India's First Industry and AI-Led Business School'.
The ad text of one ad promises to pitch to VCs and unlock placements; its video shows neither a placement figure nor a VC.
